headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when El Clon laced up for their first AEW match against Komander, appearing on Collision, rated 7.59 ? a solid showing. El Clon extended his undefeated start to his AEW career with a win over Komander, using a Matrix-style backbend into a bicycle kick and a version of Hologram's own Portal Bomb ? a pointed message to his masked rival while Don Callis celebrated in Japan.
